note: Every research study to date, one row each, from the verdicts recorded in docs/lab.md, docs/edge.md, docs/totals.md, docs/leagues.md and docs/player_props.md. CLV and ROI are per $1 against Pinnacle's margin-free close; ranges are 95% and resample matches. Nothing here has beaten Pinnacle's close.

areas.name: The match model against the price

studies.name: Model bake-offs, eight leagues
studies.question: Does any model (tuned Dixon-Coles, LightGBM, logistic, a stack) add anything to Pinnacle's early price?
studies.sample: Eight leagues, 5 model types, about 1,500–2,400 bets per model and league
studies.result: No model earns blend weight; every model's picks lose 3–7% to the close.

studies.name: Free signals (xG form, rest, soft books)
studies.question: Do free signals predict the move from Pinnacle's early price to its close well enough to bet?
studies.result: Two signals nudge the close, too weakly to bet. Best: xG form, CLV −1.6%.

studies.name: Learned minimum edge
studies.question: Is there an edge level above which the model's picks start to win?
studies.result: No band passes in any league, so every level is empty.
studies.doc: docs/lab.md: A minimum edge learned from history

studies.name: Lineup surprises
studies.question: Does a surprise in the starting XI carry information Pinnacle's close has not priced?
studies.result: Pinnacle has priced the lineup by kickoff; the surprise adds nothing beside the close.

studies.name: Residual map: where model and market disagree
studies.question: Where the model disagrees with the close, who was right, and under which conditions?
studies.result: 7 of 331 large cells stand out, fewer than the ~17 expected by chance. The close is right where the model disagrees.

studies.name: Blend Lean at Pinnacle's early price
studies.question: Does the live Lean rule beat the close in a full replay?

studies.name: Model 12% at Pinnacle's early price
studies.question: Does betting a 12% model edge beat the close?
studies.result: CLV −4.6% (below 0 in every league); ROI −5.7%.
studies.doc: docs/leagues.md: Backtests in every live league

studies.name: Model 12% at DraftKings' own prices
studies.question: Does the 12% rule fare better at the book it trades at?
studies.result: CLV −7.4%: DraftKings widens a loss that is already there.

studies.name: Blend Lean (live rule) at DraftKings' prices
studies.question: Does the Lean rule inside its odds range beat the close at DraftKings?

studies.name: Model 12% as draw no bet
studies.question: Does taking the draw out help the 12% rule?
studies.result: CLV −6.2% per stake not refunded.

studies.name: Blend Lean as draw no bet
studies.question: Does taking the draw out help Lean?
studies.result: CLV −4.2% per stake not refunded.

studies.name: Model 12% filters
studies.question: Does betting only favourites, or no long shots, rescue the 12% rule?
studies.result: Favourites only −2.7%, no long shots −3.1%, against −4.6% plain. Better, still below 0.

studies.name: Price-band edge rule
studies.question: Is there a price band where some minimum edge beats the close?
studies.result: Every band's best CLV is below 0, so the frozen rule bets nothing.

studies.name: Strategy search, 11,857 rules
studies.question: Among every combination of rule, market and filter, does any beat the close beyond luck?
studies.result: Best rule CLV +1.3%, but a no-skill search finds one that good 94% of the time (p 0.94). None found.

studies.name: Trailing favourite at half-time (B)
studies.question: Does $1 on a favourite losing at half-time beat DraftKings' in-play price?
studies.result: ROI +7.3% but the range spans 0.

studies.name: Trailing favourite at half-time (C, judged)
studies.question: The same bet on a larger, unused sample.
studies.result: ROI −25.1%: the in-play price over-prices the comeback.

studies.name: Goal timelines (ESPN)
studies.question: After the underdog scores first, how often does the favourite still win?
studies.result: +4.1 points over a score-blind model (+2.8 to +5.4), a shortfall the half-time price already covers.

studies.name: Heavy favourites (75%+) trailing
studies.question: Does a 75%+ favourite behind at half-time beat the in-play price?
studies.result: Too few bets to decide. A forward live sample continues.

studies.name: Cash out a heavy underdog at 50%
studies.question: Does cashing out a leading 4.0+ underdog beat holding, after a 5% fee?
studies.result: Growth vs holding +0.00020 a bet (−0.00022 to +0.00062): no gain after the fee.

studies.name: DraftKings vs Pinnacle's fair price
studies.question: Bet DraftKings whenever it beats Pinnacle's fair price.
studies.result: Untestable: about 15 matches a year qualify. Withdrawn before any outcome was read.
studies.doc: docs/lab.md: DraftKings vs Pinnacle's fair price

studies.name: Line shop vs Pinnacle
studies.question: Bet the best of DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM and BetRivers when it beats Pinnacle's fair price by 2%.
studies.sample: Paper track, judged once at 300 bets
studies.result: Pre-registered and live from 5 Nov; about 2.3 bets a day.

studies.name: Totals and corner bake-offs
studies.question: Do totals or team-corner models beat Pinnacle's close?
studies.result: Nothing beats the close. One finalist has a locked test left.

studies.name: Corners finalist (f), locked test
studies.question: Does model (f) pass its pre-registered test on the locked season (E0, I1, F1)?
studies.result: Waiting for its one read.

studies.name: Cup corners model
studies.question: Can a corners model price the UEFA cups?
studies.result: Failed its pre-registered test.

studies.name: Corners: only picks under 60% to win
studies.question: Do the corner tracks' picks under a 60% chance beat the close better than all picks?
studies.result: Judged on trades from 23 Oct at the 8 Dec review.

studies.name: Anytime goalscorer model quality
studies.question: Does model B predict who scores better than season goals and season xG?
studies.result: Beats season goals by +0.297 log loss (+0.249 to +0.348) and season xG by +0.057. Model quality only, not a priced test.

studies.name: Anytime goalscorer at bookmakers' prices
studies.question: Does model B beat bookmakers' anytime-goalscorer prices?
studies.result: Pre-registered; live prices logging since 1 Nov.
